title.en: Tensei Reijou wa Akumei Takai Shishakuke Toushu ~Ryouchi Unei no Tame no Keiyaku Kekkon, Uketamawarimashita~

altTitles.ja: 転生令嬢は悪名高い子爵家当主 ～領地運営のための契約結婚、承りました～

altTitles.en: The Reincarnated Noble Girl Who Became The Notorious Viscountess

description.en:
Grace, the Girl Reincarnated Into the Daughter of a Poor Viscount Family, Inherited Nothing but a Collapsing Land from Her Father.

But with her intelligence and relentless effort, Grace managed to revive this dying territory, becoming a strong leader respected by everyone.

Yet despite her success, her heart remained closed to love — especially after a painful betrayal that led to the unfair cancellation of her engagement.

One day, while accompanying her younger sister, Jessica, to her debut at a noble’s ball, something completely unexpected happened…

The famous Count, Lord Rockwell — known for his strength and striking good looks — approached her and asked for a dance, saying with a charming smile:
“Yes, I am a knight… but what I truly desire is to become your prince.”

Words Grace had never heard before…
And caught between the hesitation of her heart and the warmth of those words, she found herself unconsciously placing her hand in his — thus beginning a new story, one that might lead her to a love she had never even dared to dream of.
